name: Coral Edwardsen
office: Las Virgenes Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Coral Edwardsen is a candidate for the Las Virgenes Unified School District governing board. Her campaign website says she is a former teacher in the district. Her campaign says she supports maintaining a practical curriculum, using technology responsibly, strengthening school safety and mental health, and working with the district to use funds effectively.
